getCalendarResponse.name: missed-and-ended-days
getCalendarResponse.note: One get_calendar response (EF-1474). today is the account's calendar day; open_calendar wraps the same response as { view: 'calendar', record: { from, to, date, ...response }, related: {}, presentation }. Every day satisfies sessionCount = completed + inProgress + planned + missed + ended. Every program-backed day's summary carries programs (application EF-1575, marketplace 0.1.25): each contributing program once, in session order, with its own sessionCount; the counts sum to programSessionCount.

dayRoles.2026-09-07: trained by hand: an untapped occurrence satisfied by an unplanned completed workout, counted once
dayRoles.2026-09-09: mixed past day: a completed scheduled workout and a second schedule's untapped occurrence
dayRoles.2026-09-13: shared: two programs' untapped occurrences on a future day; programs credits each program once
dayRoles.2026-09-14: manual-led: a one-off planned workout leads a program's untapped occurrence, so the summary has no programId and programs names the program

prAwards.name: pr-award-kinds
prAwards.note: The application fixtures test/fixtures/mcp/progress-recent-prs.json and test/fixtures/mcp/personal-records.json (EF-1468, in the EF-1448 measurement contract), copied verbatim. getProgressRecentPrs is get_progress/open_progress record.recentPrs; getPersonalRecords is a get_personal_records response, whose data rows are open_exercise_progress related.records. type weight is Heaviest and type oneRm is Est. 1RM; an Est. 1RM row adds estimatedOneRm, the whole-unit Epley estimate of the lifted set (170 lb x 8 reads 215 lb).

executionGroups._note: EF-1552: grouped open_workout/open_template payloads as the application emits them; rest is the saved Activity after a set (an explicit 0 s rest, a rest after each round, two blocks in one slot).

record.title: Strength for Runners
record.summary: One strength session a week that fits around your running.
record.description: Jump squats after an easy ramp-up set, then Bulgarian split squats, Romanian deadlifts, slow calf raises and Copenhagen planks for the inner thighs and sides of the trunk. Volume stays low so the session fits beside your running week.
record.suitability: For runners with dumbbells and a bench. Copenhagen planks take some practice; keep the holds short.

record.title: Kraft für Einsteiger
record.summary: Ein fester Wochenplan mit der Langhantel, aufgebaut auf Fünfersätzen.
record.description: Kniebeuge, Bankdrücken, Kreuzheben und Schulterdrücken in Sätzen zu fünf Wiederholungen, mit Aufwärmsätzen, vollen Pausen sowie je einer Rücken- und Rumpfübung pro Tag. Die Woche wiederholt sich, und deine Gewichte werden aus dem geplant, was du tatsächlich protokollierst. Wähle zwei oder drei Tage pro Woche.
record.suitability: Für Einsteiger in einem Studio mit Langhantel, Rack, Bank, Latzug, Kabelzug und einer Kurzhantel, idealerweise nach ein paar Übungseinheiten der Grundübungen.
